// 文件路径: MES.Auth/Services/AuthService.cs
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using MES.Data.Entities;
using MES.Core.DTOs.Auth;
using MES.Core.Models;
using MES.Data;
using MES.Shared.Settings;

namespace MES.Auth.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Authentication service implementation
/// </summary>
public class AuthService : IAuthService
{
    private readonly UserManager<AppUser> _userManager;
    private readonly SignInManager<AppUser> _signInManager;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly IJwtService _jwtService;
    private readonly AppDbContext _context;

    public AuthService(
        UserManager<AppUser> userManager,
        SignInManager<AppUser> signInManager,
        IConfiguration configuration,
        IJwtService jwtService,
        AppDbContext context)
    {
        _userManager = userManager;
        _signInManager = signInManager;
        _configuration = configuration;
        _jwtService = jwtService;
        _context = context;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// User login
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<LoginResponse>> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        // Parameter validation
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.Email))
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Email cannot be empty");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.Password))
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Password cannot be empty");
        }

        // Find user
        var user = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(request.Email);
        if (user == null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Invalid username or password");
        }

        // Verify password
        var result = await _signInManager.CheckPasswordSignInAsync(user, request.Password, false);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Invalid username or password");
        }

        // Check user status
        if (!user.IsActive)
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("User account has been disabled, please contact administrator");
        }

        // Get user roles
        var roles = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);

        // Generate JWT token
        var token = await _jwtService.GenerateTokenAsync(user, roles);

        // Update last login time
        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _userManager.UpdateAsync(user);

        // Get JWT settings
        var jwtSettings = _configuration.GetSection("JwtSettings").Get<JwtSettings>();

        // Return login response
        var loginResponse = new LoginResponse
        {
            Token = token,
            Email = user.Email ?? string.Empty,
            UserName = user.UserName ?? string.Empty,
            Roles = roles.ToList(),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(jwtSettings?.ExpireMinutes ?? 480),
            FullName = user.FullName ?? string.Empty
        };

        return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Ok(loginResponse);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get current user information
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<UserInfoResponse>> GetCurrentUserAsync()
    {
        // TODO: Get current user from HttpContext
        await Task.CompletedTask;

        return ApiResponse<UserInfoResponse>.Fail("Get current user information feature to be implemented");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Logout
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<object>> LogoutAsync()
    {
        await _signInManager.SignOutAsync();
        return ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new object(), "Logout successful");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Refresh token
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<LoginResponse>> RefreshTokenAsync(string refreshToken)
    {
        // Parameter validation
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(refreshToken))
        {
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Refresh token cannot be empty");
        }

        // TODO: Implement refresh token logic
        await Task.CompletedTask;

        return ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Fail("Refresh token feature to be implemented");
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// JWT service implementation
/// </summary>
public class JwtService : IJwtService
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly UserManager<AppUser> _userManager;

    public JwtService(IConfiguration configuration, UserManager<AppUser> userManager)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _userManager = userManager;
    }

    public Task<string> GenerateTokenAsync(AppUser user, IList<string> roles)
    {
        var jwtSettings = _configuration.GetSection("JwtSettings").Get<JwtSettings>();
        if (jwtSettings == null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT configuration not found");
        }

        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtSettings.Secret));
        var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var userId = user.Id ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("User ID cannot be empty");
        var userEmail = user.Email ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("User email cannot be empty");
        var userName = user.UserName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Username cannot be empty");
        var fullName = user.FullName ?? string.Empty;

        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, userId),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, userEmail),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Name, userName),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim("fullName", fullName)
        };

        // Add role claims
        foreach (var role in roles)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, role));
        }

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: jwtSettings.Issuer,
            audience: jwtSettings.Audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(jwtSettings.ExpireMinutes),
            signingCredentials: creds
        );

        return Task.FromResult(new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token));
    }

    public string GetUsernameFromToken(string token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        try
        {
            var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
            var jwtToken = tokenHandler.ReadToken(token) as JwtSecurityToken;
            return jwtToken?.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Name)?.Value ?? string.Empty;
        }
        catch
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }
    }

    public bool ValidateToken(string token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
        {
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            var jwtSettings = _configuration.GetSection("JwtSettings").Get<JwtSettings>();
            if (jwtSettings == null)
                return false;

            var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
            var key = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtSettings.Secret);

            tokenHandler.ValidateToken(token, new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(key),
                ValidateIssuer = true,
                ValidIssuer = jwtSettings.Issuer,
                ValidateAudience = true,
                ValidAudience = jwtSettings.Audience,
                ValidateLifetime = true,
                ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
            }, out SecurityToken validatedToken);

            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

using MES.Data.Entities;

}

@page "/customers/create"
@using MES.Blazor.Services
@using MES.Core.DTOs
@using MES.Core.Enums
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@inject CustomerService CustomerService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "OrderDirector,Admin")]

<MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
    <MudCard>
        <MudCardHeader>
            <CardHeaderContent>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="font-weight-bold">
                    <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add" Class="mr-2" Color="Color.Primary" />
                    新建客户
                </MudText>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">创建新的客户档案</MudText>
            </CardHeaderContent>
            <CardHeaderActions>
                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" OnClick="GoBack">返回</MudButton>
                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="SaveCustomer" Disabled="@isSubmitting">
                    @if (isSubmitting) { <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Inherit" /> }
                    else { <span>保存</span> }
                </MudButton>
            </CardHeaderActions>
        </MudCardHeader>

        <MudCardContent>
            <MudGrid>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="客户编码" @bind-Value="customer.CustomerCode" Required="true" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="业务员" @bind-Value="customer.Salesman" Required="true" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="客户单位" @bind-Value="customer.CustomerUnit" Required="true" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="最终用户" @bind-Value="customer.EndCustomer" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudSelect T="string" Label="状态" @bind-Value="selectedStatusText" Required="true">
                        <MudSelectItem Value="@CustomerStatus.Active.ToString()">启用</MudSelectItem>
                        <MudSelectItem Value="@CustomerStatus.Inactive.ToString()">停用</MudSelectItem>
                    </MudSelect>
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系人" @bind-Value="customer.ContactPerson" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系电话" @bind-Value="customer.ContactPhone" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系地址" @bind-Value="customer.Address" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                    <MudTextField T="string" Label="备注" @bind-Value="customer.Remark" Multiline="true" />
                </MudItem>
            </MudGrid>
        </MudCardContent>
    </MudCard>
</MudContainer>

@code {
    private CreateCustomerRequest customer = new() { Status = CustomerStatus.Active };
    private bool isSubmitting;
    private string selectedStatusText = CustomerStatus.Active.ToString();

    private async Task SaveCustomer()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(customer.CustomerCode))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("客户编码不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(customer.Salesman))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("业务员不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(customer.CustomerUnit))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("客户单位不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        customer.Status = selectedStatusText == CustomerStatus.Active.ToString() ? CustomerStatus.Active : CustomerStatus.Inactive;

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await CustomerService.CreateAsync(customer);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("创建成功", Severity.Success);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/customers");
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "创建失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"创建失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/customers");
}

@page "/customers/{id:int}"
@page "/customers/{id:int}/edit"
@using MES.Blazor.Services
@using MES.Core.DTOs
@using MES.Core.Enums
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@inject CustomerService CustomerService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "OrderStaff,OrderDirector,Admin")]

<MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
    @if (isLoading)
    {
        <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate Size="Size.Large" Class="d-flex justify-center ma-8" />
    }
    else if (customer == null)
    {
        <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">客户不存在</MudAlert>
    }
    else
    {
        <MudCard>
            <MudCardHeader>
                <CardHeaderContent>
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="font-weight-bold">
                        <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Class="mr-2" Color="Color.Primary" />

                        </MudButton>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <AuthorizeView Roles="OrderDirector,Admin">
                            <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Warning" OnClick="EnterEditMode">编辑</MudButton>
                        </AuthorizeView>
                    }
                </CardHeaderActions>
            </MudCardHeader>

            <MudCardContent>
                <MudGrid>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="客户编码" @bind-Value="editCustomer.CustomerCode" Disabled="!isEditMode" Required="true" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="业务员" @bind-Value="editCustomer.Salesman" Disabled="!isEditMode" Required="true" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="客户单位" @bind-Value="editCustomer.CustomerUnit" Disabled="!isEditMode" Required="true" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="最终用户" @bind-Value="editCustomer.EndCustomer" Disabled="!isEditMode" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudSelect T="string" Label="状态" @bind-Value="selectedStatusText" Disabled="!isEditMode" Required="true">
                            <MudSelectItem Value="@CustomerStatus.Active.ToString()">启用</MudSelectItem>
                            <MudSelectItem Value="@CustomerStatus.Inactive.ToString()">停用</MudSelectItem>
                        </MudSelect>
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系人" @bind-Value="editCustomer.ContactPerson" Disabled="!isEditMode" />

                    <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系电话" @bind-Value="editCustomer.ContactPhone" Disabled="!isEditMode" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="联系地址" @bind-Value="editCustomer.Address" Disabled="!isEditMode" Multiline="true" Lines="2" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" md="12">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="备注" @bind-Value="editCustomer.Remark" Disabled="!isEditMode" Multiline="true" Lines="3" />
                    </MudItem>
                </MudGrid>
            </MudCardContent>
        </MudCard>
    }
</MudContainer>

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }
    private bool isEditMode => Navigation.Uri.Contains("/edit");
    private CustomerProfileDto? customer;
    private UpdateCustomerRequest editCustomer = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;
    private string selectedStatusText = CustomerStatus.Active.ToString();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (Id <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("无效的客户ID", Severity.Error);
            isLoading = false;
            return;
        }

        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await CustomerService.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                customer = result.Data;
                editCustomer = new UpdateCustomerRequest
                {
                    CustomerCode = customer.CustomerCode,
                    Salesman = customer.Salesman,
                    CustomerUnit = customer.CustomerUnit,
                    EndCustomer = customer.EndCustomer,
                    ContactPerson = customer.ContactPerson,
                    ContactPhone = customer.ContactPhone,
                    Address = customer.Address,
                    Status = customer.Status,
                    Remark = customer.Remark
                };
                selectedStatusText = customer.Status.ToString();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result?.Message ?? "加载数据失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载数据失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void EnterEditMode() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/customers/{Id}/edit");

    private async Task SaveCustomer()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editCustomer.CustomerCode))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("客户编码不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editCustomer.Salesman))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("业务员不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editCustomer.CustomerUnit))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("客户单位不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        editCustomer.Status = selectedStatusText == CustomerStatus.Active.ToString() ? CustomerStatus.Active : CustomerStatus.Inactive;

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await CustomerService.UpdateAsync(Id, editCustomer);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("更新成功", Severity.Success);
                Navigation.NavigateTo($"/customers/{Id}");
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "更新失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"更新失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/customers");
}

@page "/customers"
@using MES.Blazor.Services
@using MES.Core.DTOs
@using MES.Core.Models
@using MES.Core.Enums
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@inject CustomerService CustomerService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "OrderStaff,OrderDirector,Admin")]

<div class="mt-4">
    <MudCard>
        <MudCardHeader>
            <CardHeaderContent>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="font-weight-bold">
                    <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Class="mr-2" Color="Color.Primary" />
                    客户管理
                </MudText>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">客户档案信息</MudText>
            </CardHeaderContent>
            <CardHeaderActions>
                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
                           Color="Color.Primary"
                           StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
                           OnClick="NavigateToCreate">
                    新建客户
                </MudButton>
            </CardHeaderActions>
        </MudCardHeader>

        <MudCardContent>
            <!-- 搜索栏 -->
            <MudGrid>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="8">
                    <MudTextField T="string"
                                  Label="模糊搜索 - 客户编码/单位/业务员"
                                  Placeholder="输入关键字进行模糊搜索..."
                                  @bind-Value="searchKeyword"
                                  Immediate="true"
                                  DebounceInterval="500"
                                  OnKeyDown="OnSearchKeyDown"
                                  Clearable="true"
                                  ClearButton="true"
                                  Adornment="Adornment.End"
                                  AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
                    <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
                               Color="Color.Primary"
                               FullWidth="true"
                               StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
                               OnClick="Search">
                        搜索
                    </MudButton>
                </MudItem>
            </MudGrid>

            <!-- 数据表格 -->
            <MudTable @ref="table"
                      T="CustomerProfileDto"
                      ServerData="OnServerData"
                      Loading="@isLoading"
                      Dense="true"
                      Hover="true"
                      Class="mt-4"
                      Elevation="0"
                      RowsPerPageLabel="每页行数:">
                <ToolBarContent>
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="ml-auto">
                        共 @totalCount 条记录
                    </MudText>
                </ToolBarContent>
                <HeaderContent>
                    <MudTh>客户编码</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>业务员</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>客户单位</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>最终客户</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>状态</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>操作</MudTh>
                </HeaderContent>
                <RowTemplate>
                    <MudTd>@context.CustomerCode</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>@context.Salesman</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>@context.CustomerUnit</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>@context.EndCustomer</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>
                        <MudChip Size="Size.Small" Color="@(context.Status == CustomerStatus.Active ? Color.Success : Color.Error)">
                            @(context.Status == CustomerStatus.Active ? "启用" : "停用")
                        </MudChip>
                    </MudTd>
                    <MudTd>
                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility"
                                       Color="Color.Info"
                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                       OnClick="() => ViewCustomer(context.Id)" />
                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
                                       Color="Color.Warning"
                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                       OnClick="() => EditCustomer(context.Id)" />
                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
                                       Color="Color.Error"
                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                       OnClick="() => DeleteCustomer(context)" />
                    </MudTd>
                </RowTemplate>
                <PagerContent>
                    <MudTablePager />
                </PagerContent>
            </MudTable>
        </MudCardContent>
    </MudCard>
</div>

@code {
    private MudTable<CustomerProfileDto>? table;
    private List<CustomerProfileDto> customers = new();
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string searchKeyword = string.Empty;
    private int totalCount = 0;

    private async Task<TableData<CustomerProfileDto>> OnServerData(TableState state)
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var queryParams = new QueryParams
            {
                PageIndex = state.Page + 1,
                PageSize = state.PageSize,
                Keyword = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchKeyword) ? null : searchKeyword
            };

            var result = await CustomerService.GetPagedAsync(queryParams);
            
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                customers = result.Data.Items;
                totalCount = result.Data.TotalCount;
                return new TableData<CustomerProfileDto>
                {
                    Items = customers,
                    TotalItems = totalCount
                };
            }
            
            return new TableData<CustomerProfileDto>
            {
                Items = new List<CustomerProfileDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            return new TableData<CustomerProfileDto>
            {
                Items = new List<CustomerProfileDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (table != null)
        {
            await table.ReloadServerData();
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == "Enter")
        {
            _ = Search();
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToCreate() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/customers/create");
    private void ViewCustomer(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/customers/{id}");
    private void EditCustomer(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/customers/{id}/edit");

    private async Task DeleteCustomer(CustomerProfileDto customer)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm",
            $"确定要删除客户 \"{customer.CustomerUnit}\" 吗？\n\n删除后数据将不可恢复！");

        if (confirmed)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await CustomerService.DeleteAsync(customer.Id);
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("删除成功", Severity.Success);
                    await Search();
                }
                else
                {
                    Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "删除失败", Severity.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"删除失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private CreateGradeMappingRequest gradeMapping = new() { Density = 7.93m, SpecialMaterial = false };
    private bool isSubmitting;
    private decimal densityValue = 7.93m;

    protected override void OnInitialized() => densityValue = gradeMapping.Density;

    private async Task SaveGradeMapping()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gradeMapping.StandardGrade)) { Snackbar.Add("标准牌号不能为空", Severity.Warning); return; }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gradeMapping.PlantGrade)) { Snackbar.Add("工厂牌号不能为空", Severity.Warning); return; }
        gradeMapping.Density = densityValue;
        if (gradeMapping.Density <= 0) { Snackbar.Add("密度必须大于0", Severity.Warning); return; }

        isSubmitting = true; StateHasChanged();
        try
        {
            var result = await GradeMappingService.CreateAsync(gradeMapping);
            if (result.Success) { Snackbar.Add("创建成功", Severity.Success); Navigation.NavigateTo("/grade-mappings"); }
            else { Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "创建失败", Severity.Error); }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"创建失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { isSubmitting = false; StateHasChanged(); }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/grade-mappings");

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }

    private bool isEditMode => Navigation.Uri.Contains("/edit");
    private StandardGradeMappingDto? gradeMapping;
    private UpdateGradeMappingRequest editGrade = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;
    private decimal densityValue;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (Id <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"无效的 ID: {Id}", Severity.Error);
            isLoading = false;
            return;
        }
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await GradeMappingService.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                gradeMapping = result.Data;
                editGrade = new UpdateGradeMappingRequest
                {
                    StandardGrade = gradeMapping.StandardGrade,
                    PlantGrade = gradeMapping.PlantGrade,
                    Density = gradeMapping.Density,
                    HeatTreatment = gradeMapping.HeatTreatment,
                    SpecialMaterial = gradeMapping.SpecialMaterial,
                    SpecialNote = gradeMapping.SpecialNote,
                    Remark = gradeMapping.Remark
                };
                densityValue = gradeMapping.Density;
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result?.Message ?? $"加载失败，ID: {Id} 不存在", Severity.Error);
                gradeMapping = null;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载数据失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            gradeMapping = null;
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void EnterEditMode() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/grade-mappings/{Id}/edit");

    private async Task SaveGradeMapping()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editGrade.StandardGrade))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("标准牌号不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editGrade.PlantGrade))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("工厂牌号不能为空", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        editGrade.Density = densityValue;
        if (editGrade.Density == null || editGrade.Density <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("密度必须大于0", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await GradeMappingService.UpdateAsync(Id, editGrade);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("更新成功", Severity.Success);
                Navigation.NavigateTo($"/grade-mappings/{Id}");
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "更新失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"更新失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/grade-mappings");
}

@code {
    private MudTable<StandardGradeMappingDto>? table;
    private List<StandardGradeMappingDto> gradeMappings = new();
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string searchKeyword = string.Empty;
    private int totalCount = 0;

    private async Task<TableData<StandardGradeMappingDto>> OnServerData(TableState state)
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var queryParams = new QueryParams
            {
                PageIndex = state.Page + 1,
                PageSize = state.PageSize,
                Keyword = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchKeyword) ? null : searchKeyword
            };

            var result = await GradeMappingService.GetPagedAsync(queryParams);

            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                gradeMappings = result.Data.Items;
                totalCount = result.Data.TotalCount;
                return new TableData<StandardGradeMappingDto>
                {
                    Items = gradeMappings,
                    TotalItems = totalCount
                };
            }
            
            return new TableData<StandardGradeMappingDto>
            {
                Items = new List<StandardGradeMappingDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            return new TableData<StandardGradeMappingDto>
            {
                Items = new List<StandardGradeMappingDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (table != null)
        {
            await table.ReloadServerData();
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == "Enter")
        {
            _ = Search();
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToCreate() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/grade-mappings/create");
    private void ViewGradeMapping(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/grade-mappings/{id}");
    private void EditGradeMapping(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/grade-mappings/{id}/edit");

    private async Task DeleteGradeMapping(StandardGradeMappingDto mapping)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm",
            $"确定要删除牌号对照 \"{mapping.StandardGrade}\" 吗？\n\n如果该牌号已被订单使用，删除后可能导致数据问题！");

        if (confirmed)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await GradeMappingService.DeleteAsync(mapping.Id);
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("删除成功", Severity.Success);
                    await Search();
                }
                else
                {
                    Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "删除失败", Severity.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"删除失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private LoginModel model = new();
    private string errorMessage = "";
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private MudForm form = new();

    private async Task HandleLogin()
    {
        await form.Validate();
        if (!form.IsValid) return;

        isLoading = true;
        errorMessage = "";
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/auth/login", model);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                // 使用新的统一响应格式解析
                var authResponse = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<LoginResponse>>();

                if (authResponse?.Success == true && authResponse.Data != null)
                {
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("authToken", authResponse.Data.Token);
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("userEmail", authResponse.Data.Email);
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("userName", authResponse.Data.UserName);
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("userFullName", authResponse.Data.FullName);
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("userRoles", authResponse.Data.Roles);

                    if (AuthProvider is CustomAuthStateProvider customAuth)
                    {
                        customAuth.MarkUserAsLoggedIn(authResponse.Data.Token);
                    }

                    Snackbar.Add("登录成功！", Severity.Success);

                    await Task.Delay(500); // 显示成功消息的时间
                    Navigation.NavigateTo("/", true);
                }
                else
                {
                    errorMessage = authResponse?.Message ?? "登录失败";
                }
            }
            else
            {
                var errorResult = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<object>>();
                errorMessage = errorResult?.Message ?? "登录失败，请检查用户名密码";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    public class LoginModel
    {
        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Required(ErrorMessage = "邮箱不能为空")]
        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "请输入有效的邮箱地址")]
        public string Email { get; set; } = "";

        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Required(ErrorMessage = "密码不能为空")]
        public string Password { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

                    <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-3">每个订单至少需要保留一个项次。删除项次请点击行尾的删除按钮。</MudAlert>

                    <div style="overflow-x: auto;">

                            <RowTemplate Context="item">

                                                  @bind-Value="item.OuterDiameterPositiveStr"

                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"

                                                  @bind-Value="item.WallThicknessNegativeStr"

                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"

                                                  Style="width: 90px;" />
                                </MudTd>

                                <!-- 最大长度 - 文本输入 -->
                                <MudTd>
                                    <MudTextField T="string"
                                                  @bind-Value="item.MaxLengthStr"
                                                  Dense="true"
                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                                                  Size="Size.Small"
                                                  Style="width: 90px;" />
                                </MudTd>

                                <!-- 支数 - 文本输入 -->
                                <MudTd>
                                    <MudTextField T="string"
                                                  @bind-Value="item.QuantityStr"

                                </MudTd>

                                <!-- 米数 - 文本输入 + 计算按钮 -->
                                <MudTd>

                                        <MudTextField T="string"
                                                      @bind-Value="item.MetersStr"
                                                      Dense="true"
                                                      Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                                                      Size="Size.Small"
                                                      Style="width: 90px;" />
                                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Calculate"
                                                       Color="Color.Primary"
                                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                                       OnClick="() => CalculateMetersForItem(item)" />
                                    </div>
                                </MudTd>

                                <!-- 合同重量 - 文本输入 -->
                                <MudTd>
                                    <MudTextField T="string"
                                                  @bind-Value="item.ContractWeightStr"
                                                  Dense="true"
                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"

                                <!-- 理算重量 - 只读 + 计算按钮 -->
                                <MudTd>
                                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                                        <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@FormatDecimal(item.TheoreticalWeight)</MudText>
                                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Calculate"
                                                       Color="Color.Primary"
                                                       Size="Size.Small"

                                    </div>
                                </MudTd>

                                <!-- 操作 - 删除按钮 -->
                                <MudTd>
                                    @if (editItemViewModels.Count > 1)
                                    {
                                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
                                                       Color="Color.Error"
                                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                                       OnClick="() => RemoveItem(item)" />
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
                                                       Color="Color.Error"
                                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                                       Disabled="true"
                                                       Title="订单至少需要保留一个项次" />
                                    }
                                </MudTd>
                            </RowTemplate>
                        </MudTable>
                    </div>
                }
            }
        </MudCardContent>
    </MudCard>
</MudContainer>

@code {
    // ========== ViewModel 定义 ==========

    private class OrderHeaderViewModel
    {
        public string OrderNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string SignDateStr { get; set; } = DateTime.Today.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        public string CustomerCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private class OrderItemViewModel
    {
        public int Sequence { get; set; }
        public string DeliveryDateStr { get; set; } = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        public bool DelayPenalty { get; set; }
        public SettlementMethod SettlementMethod { get; set; } = SettlementMethod.Theoretical;
        public MaterialName MaterialName { get; set; } = MaterialName.SeamlessPipe;
        public int ProductionStandardId { get; set; }
        public DeliveryState DeliveryState { get; set; } = DeliveryState.SolutionAnnealedAndPickled;
        public string StandardGrade { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public LengthStatus LengthStatus { get; set; } = LengthStatus.Fixed;

        // 字符串绑定字段（用于用户输入）
        public string OuterDiameterStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string WallThicknessStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string OuterDiameterNegativeStr { get; set; } = "0";
        public string OuterDiameterPositiveStr { get; set; } = "0";
        public string WallThicknessNegativeStr { get; set; } = "0";
        public string WallThicknessPositiveStr { get; set; } = "0";
        public string MinLengthStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string MaxLengthStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string QuantityStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string MetersStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string ContractWeightStr { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        // 计算属性：将字符串转换为数值
        public decimal OuterDiameter => ParseDecimal(OuterDiameterStr);
        public decimal WallThickness => ParseDecimal(WallThicknessStr);
        public decimal OuterDiameterNegative => ParseDecimal(OuterDiameterNegativeStr);
        public decimal OuterDiameterPositive => ParseDecimal(OuterDiameterPositiveStr);
        public decimal WallThicknessNegative => ParseDecimal(WallThicknessNegativeStr);
        public decimal WallThicknessPositive => ParseDecimal(WallThicknessPositiveStr);
        public decimal? MinLength => ParseNullableDecimal(MinLengthStr);
        public decimal? MaxLength => ParseNullableDecimal(MaxLengthStr);
        public int? Quantity => ParseNullableInt(QuantityStr);
        public decimal? Meters => ParseNullableDecimal(MetersStr);
        public decimal ContractWeight => ParseDecimal(ContractWeightStr);

        // 理算重量（系统计算，只读）
        public decimal TheoreticalWeight { get; set; }

        public string? Remark { get; set; }

        private static decimal ParseDecimal(string value) => decimal.TryParse(value, out var result) ? result : 0;
        private static decimal? ParseNullableDecimal(string value) => decimal.TryParse(value, out var result) ? result : null;
        private static int? ParseNullableInt(string value) => int.TryParse(value, out var result) ? result : null;
    }

    // ========== 私有字段 ==========

    private OrderHeaderViewModel headerData = new();
    private List<OrderItemViewModel> editItemViewModels = new();
    private List<ProductionStandardDto> productionStandards = new();
    private List<StandardGradeMappingDto> gradeMappings = new();
    private List<CustomerProfileDto> allCustomers = new();
    private HashSet<string> validCustomerCodes = new();
    private bool isSubmitting = false;
    private bool isLoading = true;

    // ========== 辅助方法 ==========

    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value == 0 ? "" : value.ToString("G29");

    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value.HasValue && value.Value != 0 ? value.Value.ToString("G29") : "";

    private int? FindCustomerIdByCode(string customerCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(customerCode)) return null;
        var customer = allCustomers.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CustomerCode == customerCode);
        return customer?.Id;
    }

    // ========== 项次操作方法 ==========

    private void AddNewItem()
    {
        var newSequence = editItemViewModels.Any() ? editItemViewModels.Max(x => x.Sequence) + 1 : 1;
        editItemViewModels.Add(new OrderItemViewModel
        {
            Sequence = newSequence,
            ProductionStandardId = productionStandards.FirstOrDefault()?.Id ?? 0,
            StandardGrade = gradeMappings.FirstOrDefault()?.StandardGrade ?? string.Empty
        });
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void RemoveItem(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        if (editItemViewModels.Count <= 1)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("订单至少需要保留一个项次", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        editItemViewModels.Remove(item);
        for (int i = 0; i < editItemViewModels.Count; i++)
        {
            editItemViewModels[i].Sequence = i + 1;
        }
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void CalculateMetersForItem(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        if (item.LengthStatus == LengthStatus.Fixed)
        {
            if (item.MaxLength.HasValue && item.MaxLength > 0 && item.Quantity.HasValue && item.Quantity > 0)
            {
                var meters = Math.Round(item.MaxLength.Value * item.Quantity.Value / 1000m, 2);
                item.MetersStr = meters.ToString();
                StateHasChanged();
                Snackbar.Add($"米数已自动计算为 {meters} 米", Severity.Info);
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add("请先填写最大长度和支数", Severity.Warning);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Snackbar.Add("仅在定尺模式下支持自动计算米数", Severity.Info);
        }
    }

    private void CalculateTheoreticalWeightForItem(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        var grade = gradeMappings.FirstOrDefault(g => g.StandardGrade == item.StandardGrade);
        if (grade == null)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"标准牌号 '{item.StandardGrade}' 不存在", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        var meters = item.Meters ?? 0m;
        if (meters <= 0 && item.LengthStatus == LengthStatus.Fixed && item.MaxLength.HasValue && item.Quantity.HasValue)
        {
            meters = item.MaxLength.Value * item.Quantity.Value / 1000m;
        }

        if (meters <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("请先填写米数或定尺模式下的最大长度和支数", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        const decimal pi = 3.1416m;
        var effectiveWall = item.WallThickness - 0.5m * item.WallThicknessNegative + 0.5m * item.WallThicknessPositive;
        var effectiveOd = item.OuterDiameter - 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterNegative + 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterPositive;
        if (effectiveWall < 0) effectiveWall = 0;
        if (effectiveOd <= effectiveWall) effectiveOd = effectiveWall + 0.001m;

        var weight = grade.Density * pi * effectiveWall * (effectiveOd - effectiveWall) * meters / 1000;
        item.TheoreticalWeight = Math.Round(weight < 0 ? 0 : weight, 2);
        StateHasChanged();
        Snackbar.Add($"理算重量已计算为 {item.TheoreticalWeight} kg", Severity.Info);
    }

    // ========== 数据加载 ==========

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadDataAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadDataAsync()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            // 加载客户数据（用于验证客户编码）
            var customersResult = await CustomerService.GetPagedAsync(new QueryParams { PageSize = 1000 });
            if (customersResult.Success && customersResult.Data != null)
            {
                allCustomers = customersResult.Data.Items;
                validCustomerCodes.Clear();
                foreach (var customer in allCustomers)
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(customer.CustomerCode))
                    {
                        validCustomerCodes.Add(customer.CustomerCode);
                    }
                }
                Console.WriteLine($"加载到 {allCustomers.Count} 个客户，有效客户编码 {validCustomerCodes.Count} 个");
            }

            // 加载产品标准和牌号对照
            productionStandards = await StandardService.GetAllAsync();
            gradeMappings = await GradeMappingService.GetAllAsync();

            // 添加一个默认项次
            AddNewItem();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载数据异常: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载数据失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    // ========== 提交订单 ==========

    private async Task SubmitOrder()
    {
        if (isSubmitting) return;

        var errors = new List<string>();

        // 1. 验证基本信息
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerData.OrderNumber))
        {
            errors.Add("订单号不能为空");
        }
        else if (headerData.OrderNumber.Length != 11)
        {
            errors.Add("订单号必须为11位字符");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerData.SignDateStr))
        {
            errors.Add("请填写签订日期");
        }
        else if (!DateTime.TryParse(headerData.SignDateStr, out var signDate))
        {
            errors.Add("签订日期格式无效，请使用 yyyy-MM-dd 格式");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerData.CustomerCode))
        {
            errors.Add("客户编号不能为空");
        }
        else if (!validCustomerCodes.Contains(headerData.CustomerCode))
        {
            errors.Add($"客户编号 '{headerData.CustomerCode}' 不存在，请先在客户管理中创建");
        }

        var customerId = FindCustomerIdByCode(headerData.CustomerCode);

        // 2. 验证项次
        if (editItemViewModels.Count == 0)
        {
            errors.Add("请至少添加一个订单项次");
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < editItemViewModels.Count; i++)
        {
            var item = editItemViewModels[i];
            var seq = i + 1;

            // 交货日期验证
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.DeliveryDateStr))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 交货日期不能为空");
            }
            else if (!DateTime.TryParse(item.DeliveryDateStr, out _))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 交货日期格式无效，请使用 yyyy-MM-dd");
            }

            // 标准牌号验证
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.StandardGrade))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 标准牌号不能为空");
            }
            else if (!gradeMappings.Any(g => g.StandardGrade == item.StandardGrade))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 标准牌号 '{item.StandardGrade}' 不存在");
            }

            // 数值验证
            if (item.OuterDiameter <= 0)
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 外径必须大于0");
            }
            if (item.WallThickness <= 0)
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 壁厚必须大于0");
            }
            if (item.ContractWeight <= 0)
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 合同重量必须大于0");
            }

            // 长度状态验证
            switch (item.LengthStatus)
            {
                case LengthStatus.Fixed:
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.MinLengthStr) || item.MinLength <= 0)
                    {
                        errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 定尺时必须填写长度");
                    }
                    break;
                case LengthStatus.Range:
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.MinLengthStr) || item.MinLength <= 0 ||
                        string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.MaxLengthStr) || item.MaxLength <= 0 ||
                        item.MaxLength <= item.MinLength)
                    {
                        errors.Add($"项次 {seq}: 范围尺时必须填写最小长度和最大长度，且最大长度必须大于最小长度");
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 如果有错误，一次性显示所有错误
        if (errors.Any())
        {
            var errorMsg = string.Join("\n", errors);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", errorMsg);
            return;
        }

        // 3. 构建请求
        var items = new List<CreateOrderItemRequest>();
        foreach (var item in editItemViewModels)
        {
            // 计算米数
            var meters = item.Meters ?? 0m;
            if (item.LengthStatus == LengthStatus.Fixed && item.MaxLength.HasValue && item.Quantity.HasValue)
            {
                meters = item.MaxLength.Value * item.Quantity.Value / 1000m;
            }

            items.Add(new CreateOrderItemRequest
            {
                DeliveryDate = DateTime.Parse(item.DeliveryDateStr),
                DelayPenalty = item.DelayPenalty,
                SettlementMethod = item.SettlementMethod,
                MaterialName = item.MaterialName,
                ProductionStandardId = item.ProductionStandardId,
                DeliveryState = item.DeliveryState,
                StandardGrade = item.StandardGrade,
                OuterDiameter = item.OuterDiameter,
                WallThickness = item.WallThickness,
                OuterDiameterNegative = item.OuterDiameterNegative,
                OuterDiameterPositive = item.OuterDiameterPositive,
                WallThicknessNegative = item.WallThicknessNegative,
                WallThicknessPositive = item.WallThicknessPositive,
                LengthStatus = item.LengthStatus,
                MinLength = item.MinLength,
                MaxLength = item.MaxLength,
                Quantity = item.Quantity,
                Meters = Math.Round(meters, 2),
                ContractWeight = item.ContractWeight,
                Remark = item.Remark
            });
        }

        var request = new CreateSalesOrderRequest
        {
            OrderNumber = headerData.OrderNumber,
            SignDate = DateTime.Parse(headerData.SignDateStr),
            CustomerId = customerId!.Value,
            Items = items
        };

        // 4. 提交订单
        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await OrderService.CreateAsync(request);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"订单创建成功！订单号：{result.Data.OrderNumber}，状态：待处理", Severity.Success);
                await Task.Delay(500);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders");
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "创建订单失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"创建失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders");
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }
    private bool isEditMode => Navigation.Uri.Contains("/edit");
    private SalesOrderDetailDto? orderDetail;

    /// <summary>
    /// 编辑模式下的项次视图模型
    /// </summary>
    private class OrderItemViewModel
    {
        public int? Id { get; set; }
        public int Sequence { get; set; }
        public DateTime DeliveryDate { get; set; } = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(1);
        public bool DelayPenalty { get; set; }
        public SettlementMethod SettlementMethod { get; set; } = SettlementMethod.Theoretical;
        public MaterialName MaterialName { get; set; } = MaterialName.SeamlessPipe;
        public int ProductionStandardId { get; set; }
        public DeliveryState DeliveryState { get; set; } = DeliveryState.SolutionAnnealedAndPickled;
        public string StandardGrade { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public decimal OuterDiameter { get; set; }
        public decimal WallThickness { get; set; }
        public decimal OuterDiameterNegative { get; set; }
        public decimal OuterDiameterPositive { get; set; }
        public decimal WallThicknessNegative { get; set; }
        public decimal WallThicknessPositive { get; set; }
        public LengthStatus LengthStatus { get; set; } = LengthStatus.Fixed;
        public decimal? MinLength { get; set; }
        public decimal? MaxLength { get; set; }
        public int? Quantity { get; set; }
        public decimal? Meters { get; set; }
        public decimal ContractWeight { get; set; }
        public decimal TheoreticalWeight { get; set; }
        public string? Remark { get; set; }

        public string ProductionStandardCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string PlantGrade { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public decimal Density { get; set; }
    }

    private List<OrderItemViewModel> editItemViewModels = new();
    private List<int> itemsToDelete = new();
    private List<ProductionStandardDto> productionStandards = new();
    private List<StandardGradeMappingDto> gradeMappings = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;

    // ========== 格式化方法 ==========

    /// <summary>
    /// 格式化数值（去掉末尾多余的0）
    /// 例如：10.000 → 10, 19.050 → 19.05
    /// </summary>
    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value.ToString("G29");

    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("G29") ?? "";

    /// <summary>
    /// 格式化规格（去掉末尾多余的0）
    /// 例如：323.900*9.530 → 323.9*9.53
    /// </summary>
    private string FormatSpecification(string specification)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specification)) return "";

        var parts = specification.Split('*');
        if (parts.Length != 2) return specification;

        var od = decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var odValue) ? odValue.ToString("G29") : parts[0];
        var wt = decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var wtValue) ? wtValue.ToString("G29") : parts[1];

        return $"{od}*{wt}";
    }

    // ========== 枚举显示 ==========

    private Color GetStatusColor(SalesOrderStatus status) => status switch
    {
        SalesOrderStatus.Pending => Color.Warning,
        SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed => Color.Success,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private string GetOrderStatusText(SalesOrderStatus status) => status switch
    {
        SalesOrderStatus.Pending => "待处理",
        SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed => "已确认",
        _ => status.ToString()
    };

    private string GetSettlementMethodText(SettlementMethod method) => method switch
    {
        SettlementMethod.Theoretical => "理算",
        SettlementMethod.Weighing => "过磅",
        SettlementMethod.WeighingNegative => "过磅-负",
        _ => method.ToString()
    };

    private string GetLengthStatusText(LengthStatus status) => status switch
    {
        LengthStatus.Fixed => "定尺",
        LengthStatus.Range => "范围尺",
        LengthStatus.NonFixed => "非定尺",
        _ => status.ToString()
    };

    private string GetDeliveryStateText(DeliveryState state) => state switch
    {
        DeliveryState.SolutionAnnealedAndPickled => "固溶酸洗",
        DeliveryState.Bright => "光亮",
        DeliveryState.Hard => "硬态",
        _ => state.ToString()
    };

    private string GetMaterialNameText(MaterialName name) => name switch
    {
        MaterialName.SeamlessPipe => "无缝管",
        MaterialName.WeldedPipe => "焊管",
        _ => name.ToString()
    };

    // ========== 项次操作 ==========

    private int GetNextSequence()
    {
        if (!editItemViewModels.Any()) return 1;
        var existing = editItemViewModels.Select(vm => vm.Sequence).OrderBy(x => x).ToList();
        var next = 1;
        foreach (var seq in existing)
        {
            if (seq == next) next++;
            else if (seq > next) break;
        }
        return next;
    }

    private void AddNewItem()
    {
        var defaultStandard = productionStandards.FirstOrDefault();
        var defaultGrade = gradeMappings.FirstOrDefault();
        
        editItemViewModels.Add(new OrderItemViewModel
        {
            Id = null,
            Sequence = GetNextSequence(),
            DeliveryDate = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(1),
            SettlementMethod = SettlementMethod.Theoretical,
            MaterialName = MaterialName.SeamlessPipe,
            ProductionStandardId = defaultStandard?.Id ?? 1,
            DeliveryState = DeliveryState.SolutionAnnealedAndPickled,
            StandardGrade = defaultGrade?.StandardGrade ?? "304",
            OuterDiameter = 1,
            WallThickness = 1,
            OuterDiameterNegative = 0,
            OuterDiameterPositive = 0,
            WallThicknessNegative = 0,
            WallThicknessPositive = 0,
            LengthStatus = LengthStatus.Fixed,
            MinLength = 6000,
            MaxLength = 6000,
            Quantity = 1,
            Meters = 6,
            ContractWeight = 100,
            TheoreticalWeight = 0,
            Remark = null,
            ProductionStandardCode = defaultStandard?.StandardCode ?? "",
            PlantGrade = defaultGrade?.PlantGrade ?? "06Cr19Ni10",
            Density = defaultGrade?.Density ?? 7.93m
        });
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task RemoveItem(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        if (editItemViewModels.Count <= 1)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("订单至少需要保留一个项次", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", 
            $"确定要删除项次 {item.Sequence} 吗？\n\n删除后数据将不可恢复！");
        
        if (!confirmed) return;
        
        if (item.Id.HasValue && item.Id.Value > 0)
            itemsToDelete.Add(item.Id.Value);
        editItemViewModels.Remove(item);

        var sorted = editItemViewModels.OrderBy(x => x.Sequence).ToList();
        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.Count; i++)
            sorted[i].Sequence = i + 1;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void CalculateMetersForViewModel(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        if (item.LengthStatus == LengthStatus.Fixed)
        {
            if (item.MaxLength.HasValue && item.MaxLength > 0 && item.Quantity.HasValue && item.Quantity > 0)
            {
                item.Meters = Math.Round(item.MaxLength.Value * item.Quantity.Value / 1000m, 2);
                StateHasChanged();
                Snackbar.Add($"米数已自动计算为 {item.Meters} 米", Severity.Info);
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add("请先填写最大长度和支数", Severity.Warning);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Snackbar.Add("仅在定尺模式下支持自动计算米数", Severity.Info);
        }
    }

    private void CalculateTheoreticalWeightForViewModel(OrderItemViewModel item)
    {
        var grade = gradeMappings.FirstOrDefault(g => g.StandardGrade == item.StandardGrade);
        if (grade == null)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"标准牌号 '{item.StandardGrade}' 不存在", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        item.Density = grade.Density;
        item.PlantGrade = grade.PlantGrade;

        const decimal pi = 3.1416m;
        var effectiveWall = item.WallThickness - 0.5m * item.WallThicknessNegative + 0.5m * item.WallThicknessPositive;
        var effectiveOd = item.OuterDiameter - 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterNegative + 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterPositive;
        if (effectiveWall < 0) effectiveWall = 0;
        if (effectiveOd <= effectiveWall) effectiveOd = effectiveWall + 0.001m;

        var meters = item.Meters ?? 0m;
        var weight = grade.Density * pi * effectiveWall * (effectiveOd - effectiveWall) * meters / 1000;
        item.TheoreticalWeight = Math.Round(weight < 0 ? 0 : weight, 2);
        StateHasChanged();
        Snackbar.Add($"理算重量已计算为 {item.TheoreticalWeight} kg", Severity.Info);
    }

    // ========== 数据加载 ==========

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (Id <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("无效的订单ID", Severity.Error);
            isLoading = false;
            return;
        }
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();
        try
        {
            productionStandards = await StandardService.GetAllAsync(false);
            gradeMappings = await GradeMappingService.GetAllAsync();

            var result = await OrderService.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                orderDetail = result.Data;
                editItemViewModels = orderDetail.Items.OrderBy(i => i.Sequence).Select(i => new OrderItemViewModel
                {
                    Id = i.Id,
                    Sequence = i.Sequence,
                    DeliveryDate = i.DeliveryDate,
                    DelayPenalty = i.DelayPenalty,
                    SettlementMethod = i.SettlementMethod,
                    MaterialName = i.MaterialName,
                    ProductionStandardId = productionStandards.FirstOrDefault(s => s.StandardCode == i.ProductionStandardCode)?.Id ?? 1,
                    DeliveryState = i.DeliveryState,
                    StandardGrade = i.StandardGrade,
                    OuterDiameter = i.OuterDiameter,
                    WallThickness = i.WallThickness,
                    OuterDiameterNegative = i.OuterDiameterNegative,
                    OuterDiameterPositive = i.OuterDiameterPositive,
                    WallThicknessNegative = i.WallThicknessNegative,
                    WallThicknessPositive = i.WallThicknessPositive,
                    LengthStatus = i.LengthStatus,
                    MinLength = i.MinLength,
                    MaxLength = i.MaxLength,
                    Quantity = i.Quantity,
                    Meters = i.Meters,
                    ContractWeight = i.ContractWeight,
                    TheoreticalWeight = i.TheoreticalWeight,
                    Remark = i.Remark,
                    ProductionStandardCode = i.ProductionStandardCode,
                    PlantGrade = i.PlantGrade,
                    Density = i.Density
                }).ToList();
                itemsToDelete.Clear();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "加载失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void EnterEditMode()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{Id}/edit");
    }

    // ========== 保存 ==========

    private async Task SaveAllChanges()
    {
        if (!editItemViewModels.Any())
        {
            Snackbar.Add("订单至少需要包含一个项次", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        // 收集所有验证错误
        var errors = new List<string>();

        foreach (var item in editItemViewModels)
        {
            // 长度验证
            switch (item.LengthStatus)
            {
                case LengthStatus.Fixed:
                    if (!item.MinLength.HasValue || item.MinLength <= 0)
                        errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 定尺时必须填写长度");
                    break;
                case LengthStatus.Range:
                    if (!item.MinLength.HasValue || item.MinLength <= 0 ||
                        !item.MaxLength.HasValue || item.MaxLength <= 0 ||
                        item.MaxLength <= item.MinLength)
                        errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 范围尺时必须填写最小长度和最大长度，且最大长度必须大于最小长度");
                    break;
            }

            // 牌号验证
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.StandardGrade))
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 标准牌号不能为空");
            else if (!gradeMappings.Any(g => g.StandardGrade == item.StandardGrade))
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 标准牌号 '{item.StandardGrade}' 不存在");

            // 数值验证
            if (item.OuterDiameter <= 0)
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 外径必须大于0");
            if (item.WallThickness <= 0)
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 壁厚必须大于0");
            if (item.ContractWeight <= 0)
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence}: 合同重量必须大于0");
        }

        // 一次性显示所有错误
        if (errors.Any())
        {
            var errorMsg = string.Join("\n", errors);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", errorMsg);
            return;
        }

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            // 删除标记的项次
            foreach (var itemId in itemsToDelete)
            {
                var result = await OrderService.DeleteItemAsync(Id, itemId);
                if (!result.Success)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add($"删除项次失败: {result.Message}", Severity.Error);
                    return;
                }
            }

            // 保存每个项次
            foreach (var item in editItemViewModels)
            {
                var grade = gradeMappings.First(g => g.StandardGrade == item.StandardGrade);

                // 计算米数
                var meters = item.Meters ?? 0m;
                if (item.LengthStatus == LengthStatus.Fixed && item.MaxLength.HasValue && item.Quantity.HasValue)
                {
                    meters = item.MaxLength.Value * item.Quantity.Value / 1000m;
                    item.Meters = Math.Round(meters, 2);
                }

                // 计算理算重量
                const decimal pi = 3.1416m;
                var effectiveWall = item.WallThickness - 0.5m * item.WallThicknessNegative + 0.5m * item.WallThicknessPositive;
                var effectiveOd = item.OuterDiameter - 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterNegative + 0.5m * item.OuterDiameterPositive;
                if (effectiveWall < 0) effectiveWall = 0;
                if (effectiveOd <= effectiveWall) effectiveOd = effectiveWall + 0.001m;
                var weight = grade.Density * pi * effectiveWall * (effectiveOd - effectiveWall) * meters / 1000;
                item.TheoreticalWeight = Math.Round(weight < 0 ? 0 : weight, 2);

                if (item.Id.HasValue && item.Id.Value > 0)
                {
                    var result = await OrderService.UpdateItemAsync(Id, item.Id.Value, new UpdateOrderItemRequest
                    {
                        Sequence = item.Sequence,
                        DeliveryDate = item.DeliveryDate,
                        DelayPenalty = item.DelayPenalty,
                        SettlementMethod = item.SettlementMethod,
                        MaterialName = item.MaterialName,
                        ProductionStandardId = item.ProductionStandardId,
                        DeliveryState = item.DeliveryState,
                        StandardGrade = item.StandardGrade,
                        OuterDiameter = item.OuterDiameter,
                        WallThickness = item.WallThickness,
                        OuterDiameterNegative = item.OuterDiameterNegative,
                        OuterDiameterPositive = item.OuterDiameterPositive,
                        WallThicknessNegative = item.WallThicknessNegative,
                        WallThicknessPositive = item.WallThicknessPositive,
                        LengthStatus = item.LengthStatus,
                        MinLength = item.MinLength,
                        MaxLength = item.MaxLength,
                        Quantity = item.Quantity,
                        Meters = item.Meters,
                        ContractWeight = item.ContractWeight,
                        Remark = item.Remark
                    });
                    if (!result.Success)
                    {
                        Snackbar.Add($"更新项次 {item.Sequence} 失败: {result.Message}", Severity.Error);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var result = await OrderService.AddItemAsync(Id, new AddOrderItemRequest
                    {
                        Sequence = item.Sequence,
                        DeliveryDate = item.DeliveryDate,
                        DelayPenalty = item.DelayPenalty,
                        SettlementMethod = item.SettlementMethod,
                        MaterialName = item.MaterialName,
                        ProductionStandardId = item.ProductionStandardId,
                        DeliveryState = item.DeliveryState,
                        StandardGrade = item.StandardGrade,
                        OuterDiameter = item.OuterDiameter,
                        WallThickness = item.WallThickness,
                        OuterDiameterNegative = item.OuterDiameterNegative,
                        OuterDiameterPositive = item.OuterDiameterPositive,
                        WallThicknessNegative = item.WallThicknessNegative,
                        WallThicknessPositive = item.WallThicknessPositive,
                        LengthStatus = item.LengthStatus,
                        MinLength = item.MinLength,
                        MaxLength = item.MaxLength,
                        Quantity = item.Quantity,
                        Meters = item.Meters,
                        ContractWeight = item.ContractWeight,
                        Remark = item.Remark
                    });
                    if (!result.Success)
                    {
                        Snackbar.Add($"添加项次失败: {result.Message}", Severity.Error);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            Snackbar.Add("保存成功", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
            Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{Id}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"保存失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToRequirements() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{Id}/requirements");
    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders");
}
