    private MudTable<SalesOrderListDto>? table;
    private List<SalesOrderListDto> orders = new();
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string searchKeyword = string.Empty;
    private string selectedTechStatus = "All";
    private string selectedOrderStatus = "All";
    private int totalCount = 0;

    private bool? GetHasTechnicalRequirement() => selectedTechStatus switch
    {
        "Edited" => true,
        "NotEdited" => false,
        _ => null
    };
    
    private List<SalesOrderStatus>? GetOrderStatuses()
    {
        return selectedOrderStatus switch
        {
            "Pending" => new List<SalesOrderStatus> { SalesOrderStatus.Pending },
            "Confirmed" => new List<SalesOrderStatus> { SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed },
            "All" => new List<SalesOrderStatus> { SalesOrderStatus.Pending, SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed },
            _ => null
        };
    }

    private async Task<TableData<SalesOrderListDto>> OnServerData(TableState state)
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var queryParams = new QueryParams
            {
                PageIndex = state.Page + 1,
                PageSize = state.PageSize,
                Keyword = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchKeyword) ? null : searchKeyword
            };

            var result = await OrderService.GetPagedAsync(queryParams, GetHasTechnicalRequirement(), GetOrderStatuses());
            
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                orders = result.Data.Items;
                totalCount = result.Data.TotalCount;
                
                return new TableData<SalesOrderListDto>
                {
                    Items = orders,
                    TotalItems = totalCount
                };
            }
            
            return new TableData<SalesOrderListDto>
            {
                Items = new List<SalesOrderListDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            return new TableData<SalesOrderListDto>
            {
                Items = new List<SalesOrderListDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (table != null)
            await table.ReloadServerData();
    }

    private void OnSearchKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == "Enter")
            _ = Search();
    }
    
    private void OnTechStatusChanged(string value)
    {
        selectedTechStatus = value;
        _ = Search();
    }
    
    private void OnOrderStatusChanged(string value)
    {
        selectedOrderStatus = value;
        _ = Search();
    }

    private void NavigateToCreate() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders/create");
    private void ViewOrder(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{id}");
    private void EditOrder(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{id}/edit");
    
    private void EditTechnicalRequirement(int orderId, int itemId)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{orderId}/requirements/edit");
    }

    private async Task ConfirmOrder(SalesOrderListDto order)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm",
            $"确定要将订单 \"{order.OrderNumber}\" 确认为正式合同吗？\n\n确认后状态将变为\"已确认\"。");

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try
        {
            var updateRequest = new UpdateSalesOrderRequest
            {
                Status = "Confirmed",
                RowVersion = order.RowVersion ?? Array.Empty<byte>()
            };

            var result = await OrderService.UpdateAsync(order.Id, updateRequest);
            
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"订单 \"{order.OrderNumber}\" 已确认为正式合同", Severity.Success);
                await Search();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "确认失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"确认失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    // 取消订单 = 软删除
    private async Task CancelOrder(SalesOrderListDto order)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm",
            $"确定要取消订单 \"{order.OrderNumber}\" 吗？\n\n取消后订单将不可见，数据将保留但不可恢复！");

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try
        {
            var result = await OrderService.DeleteAsync(order.Id);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"订单 \"{order.OrderNumber}\" 已取消", Severity.Success);
                await Search();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "取消失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"取消失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private Color GetStatusColor(SalesOrderStatus status) => status switch
    {
        SalesOrderStatus.Pending => Color.Warning,
        SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed => Color.Success,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private string GetStatusText(SalesOrderStatus status) => status switch
    {
        SalesOrderStatus.Pending => "待处理",
        SalesOrderStatus.Confirmed => "已确认",
        _ => status.ToString()
    };

// 文件路径: MES.Blazor/Pages/ProductRequirement.razor
@page "/orders/{orderId:int}/requirements"
@page "/orders/{orderId:int}/requirements/edit"
@using MES.Blazor.Services
@using MES.Core.DTOs
@using MES.Core.Enums

                <CardHeaderActions>

                                else { <span>保存修改</span> }
                            </MudButton>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mb-0" Style="padding: 4px 12px;">
                                已取消的订单无法编辑技术要求
                            </MudAlert>
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        @if (orderStatus != SalesOrderStatus.Cancelled)
                        {
                            <AuthorizeView Roles="OrderDirector,Admin">
                                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Warning" OnClick="EnterEditMode">编辑技术要求</MudButton>
                            </AuthorizeView>

                        <MudTable T="ProductRequirementDto"

                                  Dense="true" 
                                  Hover="true"
                                  Elevation="0">
                            <HeaderContent>
                                <MudTh>项次</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>要求类型</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>化学成分</MudTh>

@code {
    [Parameter] public int orderId { get; set; }
    private bool isEditMode => Navigation.Uri.Contains("/edit");
    private string orderNumber = string.Empty;
    private SalesOrderStatus orderStatus = SalesOrderStatus.Pending;
    private List<ProductRequirementDto> requirements = new();
    private List<OrderItemWithRequirement> orderItemsWithRequirement = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;

    /// <summary>
    /// 项次技术要求视图模型（用于编辑）
    /// </summary>
    private class OrderItemWithRequirement
    {
        public int OrderItemId { get; set; }
        public int Sequence { get; set; }
        public bool HasExisting { get; set; }  // 是否已有技术要求记录
        public RequirementType RequirementType { get; set; } = RequirementType.Normal;
        public string? ChemicalComposition { get; set; }
        public string? MechanicalProperty { get; set; }
        public string? ToleranceRequirement { get; set; }
        public string? SurfaceQuality { get; set; }
        public string? NdtRequirement { get; set; }
        public string? OtherRequirement { get; set; }
    }

    private string FormatDateTime(DateTimeOffset dt)
    {
        return dt == DateTimeOffset.MinValue ? "-" : dt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
    }

    private string GetRequirementTypeText(RequirementType type) => type switch
    {
        RequirementType.Normal => "常规",
        RequirementType.Special => "特殊",
        _ => type.ToString()
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (orderId <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("无效的订单ID", Severity.Error);
            isLoading = false;
            return;
        }
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();
        try
        {
            var orderResult = await OrderService.GetByIdAsync(orderId);
            if (orderResult.Success && orderResult.Data != null)
            {
                orderNumber = orderResult.Data.OrderNumber;
                orderStatus = orderResult.Data.Status;
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add("无法获取订单信息", Severity.Error);
                return;
            }

            // 获取所有项次
            var allItems = orderResult.Data?.Items ?? new List<OrderItemDto>();
            
            // 获取已存在的技术要求
            var reqResult = await RequirementService.GetByOrderIdAsync(orderId);
            var existingReqs = new Dictionary<int, ProductRequirementDto>();
            if (reqResult.Success && reqResult.Data != null)
            {
                foreach (var req in reqResult.Data)
                {
                    existingReqs[req.OrderItemId] = req;
                }
            }
            
            // 构建编辑列表：所有项次都显示
            orderItemsWithRequirement = allItems.OrderBy(i => i.Sequence).Select(i => new OrderItemWithRequirement
            {
                OrderItemId = i.Id,
                Sequence = i.Sequence,
                HasExisting = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id),
                RequirementType = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].RequirementType : RequirementType.Normal,
                ChemicalComposition = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].ChemicalComposition : null,
                MechanicalProperty = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].MechanicalProperty : null,
                ToleranceRequirement = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].ToleranceRequirement : null,
                SurfaceQuality = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].SurfaceQuality : null,
                NdtRequirement = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].NdtRequirement : null,
                OtherRequirement = existingReqs.ContainsKey(i.Id) ? existingReqs[i.Id].OtherRequirement : null
            }).ToList();
            
            // 查看模式：只显示有技术要求的项次
            requirements = existingReqs.Values.OrderBy(r => r.Sequence).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void EnterEditMode()
    {
        if (orderStatus == SalesOrderStatus.Cancelled)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("已取消的订单无法编辑技术要求", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{orderId}/requirements/edit");
    }

    private async Task SaveAllRequirements()
    {
        if (orderStatus == SalesOrderStatus.Cancelled)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("已取消的订单无法保存技术要求", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();
        
        try
        {
            var savedCount = 0;
            
            // 为每个项次保存技术要求（即使内容为空）
            foreach (var item in orderItemsWithRequirement)
            {
                var request = new CreateProductRequirementRequest
                {
                    RequirementType = item.RequirementType,
                    ChemicalComposition = item.ChemicalComposition,
                    MechanicalProperty = item.MechanicalProperty,
                    ToleranceRequirement = item.ToleranceRequirement,
                    SurfaceQuality = item.SurfaceQuality,
                    NdtRequirement = item.NdtRequirement,
                    OtherRequirement = item.OtherRequirement
                };
                
                var result = await RequirementService.CreateOrUpdateAsync(orderId, item.OrderItemId, request);
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    savedCount++;
                }
                else
                {
                    Snackbar.Add($"保存项次 {item.Sequence} 技术要求失败: {result.Message}", Severity.Error);
                    return;
                }
            }
            
            Snackbar.Add($"保存成功，已保存 {savedCount} 个项次的技术要求", Severity.Success);
            
            // 重新加载数据
            await LoadData();
            Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{orderId}/requirements");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"保存失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/orders/{orderId}");
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }
    private bool isEditMode => Navigation.Uri.Contains("/edit");
    private ProductionStandardDto? standard;
    private UpdateProductionStandardRequest editStandard = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (Id <= 0) { Snackbar.Add("无效的标准ID", Severity.Error); isLoading = false; return; }
        isLoading = true; StateHasChanged();
        try
        {
            var result = await StandardService.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                standard = result.Data;
                editStandard = new UpdateProductionStandardRequest
                {
                    StandardCode = standard.StandardCode,
                    StandardName = standard.StandardName,
                    Remark = standard.Remark,
                    IsActive = standard.IsActive
                    // 移除了 SortOrder
                };
            }
            else { Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "加载失败", Severity.Error); }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { isLoading = false; StateHasChanged(); }
    }

    private void EnterEditMode() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/standards/{Id}/edit");

    private async Task SaveStandard()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editStandard.StandardCode)) { Snackbar.Add("标准编码不能为空", Severity.Warning); return; }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editStandard.StandardName)) { Snackbar.Add("标准名称不能为空", Severity.Warning); return; }

        isSubmitting = true; StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await StandardService.UpdateAsync(Id, editStandard);
            if (result.Success) { Snackbar.Add("更新成功", Severity.Success); Navigation.NavigateTo($"/standards/{Id}"); }
            else { Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "更新失败", Severity.Error); }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"更新失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { isSubmitting = false; StateHasChanged(); }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/standards");
}

<div class="mt-4">

        <MudCardHeader>
            <CardHeaderContent>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="font-weight-bold">

                    产品标准管理
                </MudText>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">生产标准/工艺标准配置</MudText>
            </CardHeaderContent>
            <CardHeaderActions>
                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
                           Color="Color.Primary"
                           StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
                           OnClick="NavigateToCreate">
                    新建标准
                </MudButton>
            </CardHeaderActions>
        </MudCardHeader>

        <MudCardContent>

                <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                    <MudTextField T="string"
                                  Label="模糊搜索 - 标准编码/名称"
                                  Placeholder="输入关键字进行模糊搜索..."
                                  @bind-Value="searchKeyword"
                                  Immediate="true"
                                  DebounceInterval="500"
                                  OnKeyDown="OnSearchKeyDown"
                                  Clearable="true"
                                  ClearButton="true"
                                  Adornment="Adornment.End"
                                  AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="3">
                    <MudSelect T="bool?" Label="状态筛选" @bind-Value="filterActive" OnValueChanged="OnFilterChanged">
                        <MudSelectItem Value="@((bool?)null)">全部</MudSelectItem>
                        <MudSelectItem Value="@((bool?)true)">已启用</MudSelectItem>
                        <MudSelectItem Value="@((bool?)false)">已停用</MudSelectItem>
                    </MudSelect>
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" md="3">
                    <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
                               Color="Color.Primary"
                               FullWidth="true"
                               StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
                               OnClick="Search">
                        搜索
                    </MudButton>
                </MudItem>
            </MudGrid>

            <MudTable @ref="table"
                      T="ProductionStandardDto"
                      ServerData="OnServerData"
                      Loading="@isLoading"
                      Dense="true"
                      Hover="true"
                      Class="mt-4"
                      Elevation="0"
                      RowsPerPageLabel="每页行数:">
                <ToolBarContent>
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="ml-auto">
                        共 @totalCount 条记录
                    </MudText>
                </ToolBarContent>
                <HeaderContent>
                    <MudTh>标准编码</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>标准名称</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>状态</MudTh>
                    <MudTh>操作</MudTh>
                </HeaderContent>
                <RowTemplate>
                    <MudTd>@context.StandardCode</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>@context.StandardName</MudTd>
                    <MudTd>
                        <MudChip Size="Size.Small" Color="@(context.IsActive ? Color.Success : Color.Error)">
                            @(context.IsActive ? "启用" : "停用")
                        </MudChip>

                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
                                       Color="Color.Warning"
                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                       OnClick="() => EditStandard(context.Id)" />
                        <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
                                       Color="Color.Error"
                                       Size="Size.Small"
                                       OnClick="() => DeleteStandard(context)" />
                    </MudTd>
                </RowTemplate>
                <PagerContent>
                    <MudTablePager />
                </PagerContent>
            </MudTable>
        </MudCardContent>
    </MudCard>
</div>

@code {
    private MudTable<ProductionStandardDto>? table;
    private List<ProductionStandardDto> standards = new();
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string searchKeyword = string.Empty;
    private bool? filterActive = null;
    private int totalCount = 0;

    private async Task<TableData<ProductionStandardDto>> OnServerData(TableState state)
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var queryParams = new QueryParams
            {
                PageIndex = state.Page + 1,
                PageSize = state.PageSize,
                Keyword = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchKeyword) ? null : searchKeyword
            };

            var result = await StandardService.GetPagedAsync(queryParams);
            
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                var items = result.Data.Items;
                if (filterActive.HasValue)
                {
                    items = items.Where(x => x.IsActive == filterActive.Value).ToList();
                }
                standards = items;
                totalCount = result.Data.TotalCount;
                return new TableData<ProductionStandardDto>
                {
                    Items = standards,
                    TotalItems = totalCount
                };
            }
            
            return new TableData<ProductionStandardDto>
            {
                Items = new List<ProductionStandardDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            return new TableData<ProductionStandardDto>
            {
                Items = new List<ProductionStandardDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (table != null)
        {
            await table.ReloadServerData();
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == "Enter")
        {
            _ = Search();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnFilterChanged(bool? value)
    {
        filterActive = value;
        if (table != null)
        {
            await table.ReloadServerData();
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToCreate() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/standards/create");
    private void ViewStandard(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/standards/{id}");
    private void EditStandard(int id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/standards/{id}/edit");

    private async Task DeleteStandard(ProductionStandardDto standard)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", 
            $"确定要删除标准 \"{standard.StandardCode}\" 吗？\n\n删除后数据将不可恢复！");
        
        if (confirmed)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await StandardService.DeleteAsync(standard.Id);
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("删除成功", Severity.Success);
                    await Search();
                }
                else
                {
                    Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "删除失败", Severity.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"删除失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }
    private WorkOrderDetailDto? workOrder;
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private List<WorkOrderListDto> siblingWorkOrders = new();
    private int currentIndex = -1;

    private bool hasPrevious => currentIndex > 0;
    private bool hasNext => currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < siblingWorkOrders.Count - 1;

    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value.ToString("G29");
    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("G29") ?? "";

    private string FormatSpecification(string specification)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specification)) return "";
        var parts = specification.Split('*');
        if (parts.Length != 2) return specification;
        var od = decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var odValue) ? odValue.ToString("G29") : parts[0];
        var wt = decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var wtValue) ? wtValue.ToString("G29") : parts[1];
        return $"{od}*{wt}";
    }

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (Id <= 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("无效的工单ID", Severity.Error);
            isLoading = false;
            return;
        }

        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                workOrder = result.Data;
                await LoadSiblingWorkOrders(workOrder.SalesOrderNo);
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "加载工单详情失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadSiblingWorkOrders(string salesOrderNo)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetBySalesOrderNoAsync(salesOrderNo);
            if (result != null && result.Success && result.Data != null && result.Data.Any())
            {
                siblingWorkOrders = result.Data.OrderBy(wo => wo.Id).ToList();
                currentIndex = siblingWorkOrders.FindIndex(wo => wo.Id == Id);
                if (currentIndex == -1)
                {
                    var currentWorkOrder = new WorkOrderListDto
                    {
                        Id = Id,
                        WorkOrderNo = workOrder?.WorkOrderNo ?? string.Empty,
                        SalesOrderNo = salesOrderNo
                    };
                    siblingWorkOrders.Insert(0, currentWorkOrder);
                    currentIndex = 0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                siblingWorkOrders = new List<WorkOrderListDto>();
                currentIndex = -1;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载工单列表异常: {ex.Message}");
            siblingWorkOrders = new List<WorkOrderListDto>();
            currentIndex = -1;
        }
    }

    private void GoToPrevious()
    {
        if (hasPrevious)
        {
            var previousWorkOrder = siblingWorkOrders[currentIndex - 1];
            Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/{previousWorkOrder.Id}");
        }
    }

    private void GoToNext()
    {
        if (hasNext)
        {
            var nextWorkOrder = siblingWorkOrders[currentIndex + 1];
            Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/{nextWorkOrder.Id}");
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToItems()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/{Id}/items");
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");

    private Color GetStatusColor(int status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            0 => Color.Default,
            1 => Color.Success,
            2 => Color.Warning,
            3 => Color.Error,
            _ => Color.Default
        };
    }

    private string GetMaterialNameText(string materialName)
    {
        return materialName switch
        {
            "SeamlessPipe" => "无缝管",
            "WeldedPipe" => "焊管",
            _ => materialName
        };
    }

    private string GetSettlementMethodText(string method)
    {
        return method switch
        {
            "Theoretical" => "理算",
            "Weighing" => "过磅",
            "WeighingNegative" => "过磅-负",
            _ => method
        };
    }

    private string GetDeliveryStateText(string state)
    {
        return state switch
        {
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickled" => "固溶酸洗",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledUTube" => "固溶酸洗-U型管",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledExternalPolished" => "固溶酸洗-外抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledInternalPolished" => "固溶酸洗-内抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledBothPolished" => "固溶酸洗-内外抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledCoiled" => "固溶酸洗-盘管",
            "Bright" => "光亮",
            "BrightUTube" => "光亮-U型管",
            "BrightCoiled" => "光亮-盘管",
            "Hard" => "硬态",
            _ => state
        };
    }

    private string GetLengthStatusText(string status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            "Fixed" => "定尺",
            "Range" => "范围尺",
            "NonFixed" => "非定尺",
            _ => status
        };
    }
}

                        }
                    </MudButton>
                </CardHeaderActions>
            </MudCardHeader>

            <MudCardContent>
                @if (orderItems == null || !orderItems.Any())

                            <li>定尺模式下次号必填（格式：C + 两位数字）</li>
                            <li>范围尺/非定尺模式下次号无需填写</li>
                            @if (workOrderStatus == "Confirmed" && isRegenerate)
                            {
                                <li><strong>重新生成模式：将保留原主号/次号，可手动修改后提交</strong></li>
                            }
                            @if (workOrderStatus == "Pending")
                            {
                                <li><strong>待修正模式：订单项次已变更，将全新生成工单（不保留原编号）</strong></li>
                            }
                        </ul>
                    </MudAlert>

                    <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
                        <MudTable T="OrderItemForWorkOrderDto"
                                  Items="@orderItems"
                                  Dense="true"
                                  Hover="true"
                                  Elevation="0">
                            <HeaderContent>
                                <MudTh>项次</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>物料名称</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>交货日期</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>交货状态</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>工厂牌号</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>规格</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>长度状态</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>最小长度</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>最大长度</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>数量(支)</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>米数</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>合同重量</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>主号</MudTh>
                                <MudTh>次号</MudTh>
                            </HeaderContent>
                            <RowTemplate Context="item">
                                <MudTd>@item.Sequence</MudTd>

                                                  Immediate="true" />

                                                  @bind-Value="subNoMap[item.Id]"
                                                  Dense="true"
                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                                                  Size="Size.Small"
                                                  Style="width: 80px;"
                                                  Placeholder="定尺时必填"
                                                  Immediate="true" />
                                </MudTd>
                            </RowTemplate>
                        </MudTable>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? salesOrderNo { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? status { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public bool isRegenerate { get; set; }

    private string workOrderStatus => status ?? "NotGenerated";
    private List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>? orderItems;
    private Dictionary<int, string> subNoMap = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSubmitting;

    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value.ToString("G29");
    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("G29") ?? "";

    private string FormatSpecification(string specification)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specification)) return "";
        var parts = specification.Split('*');
        if (parts.Length != 2) return specification;
        var od = decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var odValue) ? odValue.ToString("G29") : parts[0];
        var wt = decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var wtValue) ? wtValue.ToString("G29") : parts[1];
        return $"{od}*{wt}";
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(salesOrderNo))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("订单号不能为空", Severity.Error);
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
            return;
        }

        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetOrderItemsForWorkOrderAsync(salesOrderNo);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null && result.Data.Any())
            {
                orderItems = result.Data;
                foreach (var item in orderItems)
                {
                    subNoMap[item.Id] = string.Empty;

                    // 覆盖生成（重新生成）时，预填原主号/次号
                    if (isRegenerate && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.OriginalMainNo))
                    {
                        item.SuggestedMainNo = item.OriginalMainNo;
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.OriginalSubNo))
                        {
                            subNoMap[item.Id] = item.OriginalSubNo;
                        }
                    }
                    // 待修正生成不预填，保持系统建议主号
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "获取订单项次失败", Severity.Error);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private string GetMergeKey(OrderItemForWorkOrderDto item)
    {
        return $"{item.DeliveryDate:yyyy-MM-dd}|{item.DelayPenalty}|{item.MaterialName}|{item.SettlementMethod}|" +
               $"{item.StandardCode}|{item.DeliveryState}|{item.PlantGrade}|{item.Specification}|" +
               $"{item.OuterDiameterMinus}|{item.OuterDiameterPlus}|{item.WallThicknessMinus}|" +
               $"{item.WallThicknessPlus}|{item.LengthStatus}";
    }

    private async Task SubmitWorkOrders()
    {
        if (orderItems == null || !orderItems.Any())
        {
            Snackbar.Add("没有可生成的工单项次", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        var errors = new List<string>();

        // 按主号分组
        var groups = new Dictionary<string, List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>>();
        foreach (var item in orderItems)
        {
            var mainNo = item.SuggestedMainNo;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(mainNo))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence} 的主号不能为空");
                continue;
            }
            if (!groups.ContainsKey(mainNo))
                groups[mainNo] = new List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>();
            groups[mainNo].Add(item);
        }

        if (errors.Any())
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", string.Join("\n", errors));
            return;
        }

        // 验证每个分组内的合并字段一致性
        foreach (var group in groups)
        {
            var mainNo = group.Key;
            var itemsInGroup = group.Value;
            if (itemsInGroup.Count <= 1) continue;

            var baseMergeKey = GetMergeKey(itemsInGroup.First());
            var inconsistentItems = new List<int>();
            foreach (var item in itemsInGroup.Skip(1))
            {
                if (GetMergeKey(item) != baseMergeKey)
                    inconsistentItems.Add(item.Sequence);
            }
            if (inconsistentItems.Any())
            {
                errors.Add($"主号 {mainNo} 下的项次 {string.Join(",", inconsistentItems)} 与组内其他项次规格参数不一致，不能合并到同一主号");
            }
        }

        // 验证次号
        foreach (var item in orderItems)
        {
            var lengthStatus = item.LengthStatus;
            var subNo = subNoMap.GetValueOrDefault(item.Id);
            if (lengthStatus == "Fixed" && string.IsNullOrEmpty(subNo))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence} 为定尺模式，次号不能为空（格式：C+两位数字）");
            }
            else if (lengthStatus == "Fixed" && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(subNo) && !System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(subNo, @"^C\d{2}$"))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence} 的次号格式错误，应为 C+两位数字（如 C01）");
            }
            else if (lengthStatus != "Fixed" && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(subNo))
            {
                errors.Add($"项次 {item.Sequence} 为{GetLengthStatusText(lengthStatus)}模式，不需要填写次号");
            }
        }

        if (errors.Any())
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", string.Join("\n", errors));
            return;
        }

        var workOrderGroups = new List<WorkOrderItemGroup>();
        foreach (var group in groups)
        {
            string? subNo = null;
            foreach (var item in group.Value)
            {
                var tempSubNo = subNoMap.GetValueOrDefault(item.Id);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tempSubNo))
                {
                    subNo = tempSubNo;
                    break;
                }
            }
            workOrderGroups.Add(new WorkOrderItemGroup
            {
                ProductionMainNo = group.Key,
                ProductionSubNo = subNo,
                OrderItemIds = group.Value.Select(x => x.Id).ToList()
            });
        }

        var request = new CreateWorkOrderRequest
        {
            SalesOrderNo = salesOrderNo!,
            WorkOrders = workOrderGroups,
            IsRegenerate = isRegenerate
        };

        isSubmitting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GenerateWorkOrdersAsync(request);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null && result.Data.Any())
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"成功生成 {result.Data.Count} 个工单", Severity.Success);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "生成工单失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"生成失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");

    private string GetMaterialNameText(string materialName)
    {
        return materialName switch
        {
            "SeamlessPipe" => "无缝管",
            "WeldedPipe" => "焊管",
            _ => materialName
        };
    }

    private string GetLengthStatusText(string lengthStatus)
    {
        return lengthStatus switch
        {
            "Fixed" => "定尺",
            "Range" => "范围尺",
            "NonFixed" => "非定尺",
            _ => lengthStatus
        };
    }

    private string GetDeliveryStateText(string deliveryState)
    {
        return deliveryState switch
        {
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickled" => "固溶酸洗",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledUTube" => "固溶酸洗-U型管",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledExternalPolished" => "固溶酸洗-外抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledInternalPolished" => "固溶酸洗-内抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledBothPolished" => "固溶酸洗-内外抛光",
            "SolutionAnnealedAndPickledCoiled" => "固溶酸洗-盘管",
            "Bright" => "光亮",
            "BrightUTube" => "光亮-U型管",
            "BrightCoiled" => "光亮-盘管",
            "Hard" => "硬态",
            _ => deliveryState
        };
    }
}

    [Parameter] public int WorkOrderId { get; set; }
    private List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>? orderItems;

    private string productionMainNo = string.Empty;
    private string? productionSubNo;
    private bool isLoading = true;

    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value.ToString("G29");
    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("G29") ?? "";

    private string FormatSpecification(string specification)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specification)) return "";
        var parts = specification.Split('*');
        if (parts.Length != 2) return specification;
        var od = decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var odValue) ? odValue.ToString("G29") : parts[0];
        var wt = decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var wtValue) ? wtValue.ToString("G29") : parts[1];
        return $"{od}*{wt}";
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            // 获取工单基本信息
            var orderResult = await WorkOrderService.GetByIdAsync(WorkOrderId);
            if (orderResult.Success && orderResult.Data != null)
            {
                workOrderNo = orderResult.Data.WorkOrderNo;
                productionMainNo = orderResult.Data.ProductionMainNo;
                productionSubNo = orderResult.Data.ProductionSubNo;
            }

            // 获取项次明细
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetWorkOrderItemsAsync(WorkOrderId);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                orderItems = result.Data;
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "获取项次明细失败", Severity.Error);
                orderItems = new List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            orderItems = new List<OrderItemForWorkOrderDto>();
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

@code {
    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? salesOrderNo { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()

        {
            Snackbar.Add("订单号不能为空", Severity.Error);
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
            return;
        }

        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetOrderWorkOrderRelationAsync(salesOrderNo);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                relation = result.Data;
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "获取数据失败", Severity.Error);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void NavigateToWorkOrder(int workOrderId)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/{workOrderId}");
    }

    private void GoBack()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/workorders");
    }

    private string FormatDecimal(decimal value) => value.ToString("G29");
    private string FormatNullableDecimal(decimal? value) => value?.ToString("G29") ?? "";

    private string FormatSpecification(string specification)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(specification)) return "";
        var parts = specification.Split('*');
        if (parts.Length != 2) return specification;
        var od = decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var odValue) ? odValue.ToString("G29") : parts[0];
        var wt = decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var wtValue) ? wtValue.ToString("G29") : parts[1];
        return $"{od}*{wt}";
    }

    private Color GetStatusColor(int status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            0 => Color.Default,
            1 => Color.Success,
            2 => Color.Warning,
            3 => Color.Error,
            _ => Color.Default
        };
    }

    private string GetMaterialNameText(string materialName)
    {
        return materialName switch
        {
            "SeamlessPipe" => "无缝管",
            "WeldedPipe" => "焊管",
            _ => materialName
        };
    }

    private string GetLengthStatusText(string lengthStatus)
    {
        return lengthStatus switch
        {
            "Fixed" => "定尺",
            "Range" => "范围尺",
            "NonFixed" => "非定尺",
            _ => lengthStatus
        };
    }
}

    private MudTable<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>? table;
    private MudTable<OrderChangeNotificationDto>? notificationTable;
    private List<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto> orders = new();
    private List<CancelledOrderDto> cancelledOrders = new();
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string searchKeyword = string.Empty;
    private string selectedStatus = string.Empty;
    private int totalCount = 0;

    // 通知相关
    private bool notificationDrawerOpen = false;
    private int unreadCount = 0;
    private bool isLoadingNotifications = false;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadUnreadCount();
        await LoadCancelledOrders();
        await base.OnInitializedAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadUnreadCount()
    {
        var result = await NotificationService.GetUnreadCountAsync();
        if (result.Success)
            unreadCount = result.Data;
    }

    private async Task<TableData<OrderChangeNotificationDto>> LoadNotifications(TableState state)
    {
        isLoadingNotifications = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var result = await NotificationService.GetPagedAsync(state.Page + 1, state.PageSize);
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                return new TableData<OrderChangeNotificationDto>
                {
                    Items = result.Data.Items,
                    TotalItems = result.Data.TotalCount
                };
            }
            return new TableData<OrderChangeNotificationDto> { Items = new List<OrderChangeNotificationDto>(), TotalItems = 0 };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoadingNotifications = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task MarkNotificationRead(int id)
    {
        var result = await NotificationService.MarkAsReadAsync(id);
        if (result.Success)
        {
            await notificationTable?.ReloadServerData();
            await LoadUnreadCount();
            Snackbar.Add("已标记为已读", Severity.Success);
        }
        else
        {
            Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "操作失败", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private async Task MarkAllNotificationsRead()
    {
        var result = await NotificationService.MarkAllAsReadAsync();
        if (result.Success)
        {
            await notificationTable?.ReloadServerData();
            await LoadUnreadCount();
            Snackbar.Add("已全部标记为已读", Severity.Success);
        }
        else
        {
            Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "操作失败", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadCancelledOrders()
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetCancelledOrdersAsync();
            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                cancelledOrders = result.Data;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载待删除订单失败: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private async Task<TableData<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>> OnServerData(TableState state)
    {
        isLoading = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var queryParams = new WorkOrderQueryParams
            {
                PageIndex = state.Page + 1,
                PageSize = state.PageSize,
                SortBy = "SignDate",
                IsDescending = true,
                Keyword = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchKeyword) ? null : searchKeyword,
                WorkOrderStatus = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selectedStatus) ? null : selectedStatus
            };

            var result = await WorkOrderService.GetOrderWorkOrderStatusPageAsync(queryParams);

            if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
            {
                orders = result.Data.Items;
                totalCount = result.Data.TotalCount;
            }
            else
            {
                orders = new List<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>();
                totalCount = 0;
            }

            return new TableData<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>
            {
                Items = orders,
                TotalItems = totalCount
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
            Snackbar.Add($"加载失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            return new TableData<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>
            {
                Items = new List<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>(),
                TotalItems = 0
            };
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (table != null)
            await table.ReloadServerData();
        await LoadCancelledOrders();
    }

    private void OnSearchKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == "Enter")
            _ = Search();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(string status)
    {
        selectedStatus = status;
        await Search();
    }

    private Color GetStatusColor(string status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            "NotGenerated" => Color.Default,
            "Confirmed" => Color.Success,
            "Pending" => Color.Warning,
            _ => Color.Default
        };
    }

    private void ViewWorkOrder(int workOrderId)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/{workOrderId}");
    }

    private void NavigateToGenerate(string salesOrderNo, string workOrderStatus)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/generate?salesOrderNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(salesOrderNo)}&status={workOrderStatus}");
    }

    private void NavigateToRegenerate(string salesOrderNo, string workOrderStatus)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/generate?salesOrderNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(salesOrderNo)}&status={workOrderStatus}&regenerate=true");
    }

    private void NavigateToTrace(string orderNumber)
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/workorders/relation?salesOrderNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(orderNumber)}");
    }

    private async Task SoftDeleteWorkOrder(int workOrderId, string orderNumber)
    {
        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm",
            $"确定要删除订单 \"{orderNumber}\" 关联的工单吗？\n\n删除后数据将不可恢复！");
        if (!confirmed) return;

        try
        {
            var result = await WorkOrderService.SoftDeleteAsync(workOrderId);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"工单已删除", Severity.Success);
                await LoadCancelledOrders();
                await Search();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add(result.Message ?? "删除失败", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"删除失败: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
}

// 文件路径: MES.Blazor/Services/AuthHttpClient.cs
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using Blazored.LocalStorage;

namespace MES.Blazor.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 带认证功能的 HTTP 客户端
/// </summary>
public class AuthHttpClient
{
    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly ILocalStorageService _localStorage;

    public AuthHttpClient(HttpClient http, ILocalStorageService localStorage)
    {
        _http = http;
        _localStorage = localStorage;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 添加认证 Token 到请求头
    /// </summary>
    private async Task AddAuthHeaderAsync()
    {
        var token = await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<string>("authToken");
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
        {
            _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// GET 请求
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<HttpResponseMessage> GetAsync(string url)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        return await _http.GetAsync(url);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// GET 请求并反序列化为 T
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<T?> GetFromJsonAsync<T>(string url)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        var response = await _http.GetAsync(url);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return default;
        }
        
        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions 
        { 
            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true 
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST 请求
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<HttpResponseMessage> PostAsJsonAsync<T>(string url, T data)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        return await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, data);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST 请求并反序列化响应
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<TResponse?> PostAsJsonAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(string url, TRequest data)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, data);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return default;
        }
        
        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TResponse>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions 
        { 
            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true 
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PUT 请求
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<HttpResponseMessage> PutAsJsonAsync<T>(string url, T data)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        return await _http.PutAsJsonAsync(url, data);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PUT 请求并反序列化响应
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<TResponse?> PutAsJsonAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(string url, TRequest data)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        var response = await _http.PutAsJsonAsync(url, data);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return default;
        }
        
        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TResponse>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions 
        { 
            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true 
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DELETE 请求
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<HttpResponseMessage> DeleteAsync(string url)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        return await _http.DeleteAsync(url);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DELETE 请求并反序列化响应
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<T?> DeleteFromJsonAsync<T>(string url)
    {
        await AddAuthHeaderAsync();
        var response = await _http.DeleteAsync(url);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return default;
        }
        
        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions 
        { 
            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true 
        });
    }
}

FILE: MES.Blazor\Services\CustomAuthStateProvider.cs
======================================================================

using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Blazored.LocalStorage;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace MES.Blazor.Services;

public class CustomAuthStateProvider : AuthenticationStateProvider
{
    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly ILocalStorageService _localStorage;

    public CustomAuthStateProvider(HttpClient http, ILocalStorageService localStorage)
    {
        _http = http;
        _localStorage = localStorage;
    }

    public override async Task<AuthenticationState> GetAuthenticationStateAsync()
    {
        var token = await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<string>("authToken");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
            return new AuthenticationState(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity()));

        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("bearer", token);
        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(ParseClaimsFromJwt(token), "jwt");
        var user = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);
        return new AuthenticationState(user);
    }

    public void MarkUserAsLoggedIn(string token)
    {
        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(ParseClaimsFromJwt(token), "jwt");
        var user = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);
        NotifyAuthenticationStateChanged(Task.FromResult(new AuthenticationState(user)));
    }

    public async Task MarkUserAsLoggedOut()
    {
        await _localStorage.RemoveItemAsync("authToken");
        _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = null;
        NotifyAuthenticationStateChanged(Task.FromResult(new AuthenticationState(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity()))));
    }

    private static IEnumerable<Claim> ParseClaimsFromJwt(string jwt)
    {
        try
        {
            var payload = jwt.Split('.')[1];
            var jsonBytes = ParseBase64WithoutPadding(payload);
            var keyValuePairs = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, object>>(jsonBytes);
            return keyValuePairs?.Select(kvp => new Claim(kvp.Key, kvp.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)) 
                   ?? new List<Claim>();
        }
        catch
        {
            return new List<Claim>();
        }
    }

    private static byte[] ParseBase64WithoutPadding(string base64)
    {
        switch (base64.Length % 4)
        {
            case 2: base64 += "=="; break;
            case 3: base64 += "="; break;
        }
        return Convert.FromBase64String(base64);
    }
}

// 文件路径: MES.Blazor/Services/CustomerService.cs
using MES.Core.DTOs;
using MES.Core.Models;

namespace MES.Blazor.Services;

public class CustomerService
{
    private readonly AuthHttpClient _http;
    private const string BaseUrl = "api/customer";

    public CustomerService(AuthHttpClient http)
    {
        _http = http;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 分页查询客户列表（支持关键字搜索）
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<CustomerProfileDto>>> GetPagedAsync(QueryParams query)
    {
        try
        {
            // 使用小写的 true/false
            var isDescending = query.IsDescending ? "true" : "false";
            var encodedSortBy = Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SortBy ?? "CreatedTime");

            var url = $"{BaseUrl}/list?pageIndex={query.PageIndex}&pageSize={query.PageSize}&sortBy={encodedSortBy}&isDescending={isDescending}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Keyword))
            {
                url += $"&keyword={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Keyword)}";
            }

            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<PagedResult<CustomerProfileDto>>>(url);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<PagedResult<CustomerProfileDto>>.Fail("获取数据失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<CustomerProfileDto>>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 获取所有客户（用于下拉框）
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<List<CustomerProfileDto>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var result = await GetPagedAsync(new QueryParams { PageSize = 999, Keyword = null });
        if (result.Success && result.Data != null)
        {
            return result.Data.Items;
        }
        return new List<CustomerProfileDto>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 根据ID获取客户详情
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>> GetByIdAsync(int id)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>>($"{BaseUrl}/{id}");
            return response ?? ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail("获取数据失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 创建客户
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>> CreateAsync(CreateCustomerRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync<CreateCustomerRequest, ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>>(BaseUrl, request);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail("创建失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 更新客户
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>> UpdateAsync(int id, UpdateCustomerRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.PutAsJsonAsync<UpdateCustomerRequest, ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>>($"{BaseUrl}/{id}", request);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail("更新失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<CustomerProfileDto>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// </summary>

    {

    private readonly AuthHttpClient _http;
    private const string BaseUrl = "api/order";

    public OrderService(AuthHttpClient http)
    {
        _http = http;
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<SalesOrderListDto>>> GetPagedAsync(
        QueryParams query, 
        bool? hasTechnicalRequirement = null, 
        List<SalesOrderStatus>? statuses = null)
    {
        try
        {
            var url = $"{BaseUrl}/list?pageIndex={query.PageIndex}&pageSize={query.PageSize}&sortBy={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SortBy)}&isDescending={query.IsDescending}";
            
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Keyword))
                url += $"&keyword={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Keyword)}";
            
            if (hasTechnicalRequirement.HasValue)
                url += $"&technicalStatus={(hasTechnicalRequirement.Value ? "Edited" : "NotEdited")}";
            
            if (statuses != null && statuses.Any())
            {
                var statusParam = string.Join(",", statuses.Select(s => s.ToString()));
                url += $"&orderStatus={Uri.EscapeDataString(statusParam)}";
            }
            
            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<PagedResult<SalesOrderListDto>>>(url);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<PagedResult<SalesOrderListDto>>.Fail("获取订单列表失败");

        {
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<SalesOrderListDto>>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");

        int orderId,

        CreateProductRequirementRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync<CreateProductRequirementRequest, ApiResponse<ProductRequirementDto>>(
                $"api/order/{orderId}/items/{itemId}/requirement", request);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<ProductRequirementDto>.Fail("保存产品要求失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<ProductRequirementDto>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 删除产品要求
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<object>> DeleteAsync(int orderId, int itemId)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.DeleteFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<object>>(
                $"api/order/{orderId}/items/{itemId}/requirement");
            return response ?? ApiResponse<object>.Fail("删除产品要求失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<object>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 获取订单下所有项次的产品要求列表
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<ProductRequirementDto>>> GetByOrderIdAsync(int orderId)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<List<ProductRequirementDto>>>(
                $"api/order/{orderId}/requirements");
            
            if (response != null && response.Success && response.Data == null)
            {
                response.Data = new List<ProductRequirementDto>();
            }
            
            return response ?? ApiResponse<List<ProductRequirementDto>>.Fail("获取技术要求列表失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<List<ProductRequirementDto>>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}

using MES.Core.DTOs;
using MES.Core.Models;

namespace MES.Blazor.Services;

/// </summary>
public class WorkOrderService
{
    private readonly AuthHttpClient _http;
    private const string BaseUrl = "api/workorder";

    public WorkOrderService(AuthHttpClient http)
    {
        _http = http;
    }

    #region 工单首页（订单状态监控）

    /// <summary>
    /// 获取工单首页订单列表（含工单状态）
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>>> GetOrderWorkOrderStatusPageAsync(WorkOrderQueryParams query)
    {
        try
        {
            var url = $"{BaseUrl}/order-status?pageIndex={query.PageIndex}&pageSize={query.PageSize}&sortBy={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SortBy)}&isDescending={query.IsDescending}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Keyword))
                url += $"&keyword={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Keyword)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.SalesOrderNo))
                url += $"&salesOrderNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SalesOrderNo)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Salesman))
                url += $"&salesman={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Salesman)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.EndCustomer))
                url += $"&endCustomer={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.EndCustomer)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.WorkOrderStatus))
                url += $"&workOrderStatus={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.WorkOrderStatus)}";

            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<PagedResult<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>>>(url);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<PagedResult<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>>.Fail("获取数据失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<OrderWorkOrderStatusDto>>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 分页查询工单列表
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<WorkOrderListDto>>> GetPagedAsync(WorkOrderQueryParams query)
    {
        try
        {
            var url = $"{BaseUrl}/list?pageIndex={query.PageIndex}&pageSize={query.PageSize}&sortBy={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SortBy)}&isDescending={query.IsDescending}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Keyword))
                url += $"&keyword={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Keyword)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.SalesOrderNo))
                url += $"&salesOrderNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.SalesOrderNo)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.ProductionMainNo))
                url += $"&productionMainNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.ProductionMainNo)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.ProductionSubNo))
                url += $"&productionSubNo={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.ProductionSubNo)}";
            if (query.Status.HasValue)
                url += $"&status={query.Status.Value}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.MaterialName))
                url += $"&materialName={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.MaterialName)}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Specification))
                url += $"&specification={Uri.EscapeDataString(query.Specification)}";
            if (query.DeliveryDateStart.HasValue)
                url += $"&deliveryDateStart={query.DeliveryDateStart.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}";
            if (query.DeliveryDateEnd.HasValue)
                url += $"&deliveryDateEnd={query.DeliveryDateEnd.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}";

            var response = await _http.GetFromJsonAsync<ApiResponse<PagedResult<WorkOrderListDto>>>(url);
            return response ?? ApiResponse<PagedResult<WorkOrderListDto>>.Fail("获取数据失败");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<WorkOrderListDto>>.Fail($"网络错误: {ex.Message}");
        }

@code {
    private bool _drawerOpen = false;
    private AuthenticationState? _authenticationState;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        AuthProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged += OnAuthenticationStateChanged;
        _authenticationState = await AuthProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        _drawerOpen = _authenticationState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
    }

    private async void OnAuthenticationStateChanged(Task<AuthenticationState> task)
    {
        await InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            _authenticationState = await task;
            _drawerOpen = _authenticationState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
            StateHasChanged();
        });
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        AuthProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged -= OnAuthenticationStateChanged;
    }

    private void DrawerToggle() => _drawerOpen = !_drawerOpen;

    private void NavigateToLogin() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/login");

    private async Task Logout()
    {
        if (AuthProvider is CustomAuthStateProvider customAuth)
        {
            await customAuth.MarkUserAsLoggedOut();
        }
        else
        {
            try
            {
                await LocalStorage.RemoveItemAsync("authToken");
                await LocalStorage.RemoveItemAsync("refreshToken");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Logout error: {ex.Message}");
            }

            await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.removeItem", "authToken");
            await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.removeItem", "refreshToken");
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/", true);
        }
    }
}

// 文件路径: MES.Core/DTOs/AddOrderItemRequest.cs
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using MES.Core.Enums;

namespace MES.Core.DTOs;

/// <summary>
/// 添加订单项次请求
/// </summary>
public class AddOrderItemRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 项次号（可选，不填则自动追加到末尾）
    /// </summary>
    public int? Sequence { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 交货日期
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "交货日期不能为空")]
    public DateTime DeliveryDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 是否延期违约金（默认false）
    /// </summary>
    public bool DelayPenalty { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 结算方式
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "结算方式不能为空")]
    public SettlementMethod SettlementMethod { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 物料名称
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "物料名称不能为空")]
    public MaterialName MaterialName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 产品标准ID
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "产品标准不能为空")]
    public int ProductionStandardId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 交货状态
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "交货状态不能为空")]
    public DeliveryState DeliveryState { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 标准牌号
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "标准牌号不能为空")]
    public string StandardGrade { get; set; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// 外径
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "外径不能为空")]
    public decimal OuterDiameter { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 壁厚
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "壁厚不能为空")]
    public decimal WallThickness { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 外径下偏差（默认0）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal OuterDiameterNegative { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 外径上偏差（默认0）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal OuterDiameterPositive { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 壁厚下偏差（默认0）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal WallThicknessNegative { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 壁厚上偏差（默认0）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal WallThicknessPositive { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 长度状态
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "长度状态不能为空")]
    public LengthStatus LengthStatus { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 最小长度（Fixed/Range时必填）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal? MinLength { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 最大长度（Range时必填）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal? MaxLength { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 数量（默认0）
    /// </summary>
    public int? Quantity { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 米数（Range/NonFixed时必填）
    /// </summary>
    public decimal? Meters { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 合同重量
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "合同重量不能为空")]
    public decimal ContractWeight { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 备注
    /// </summary>
    public string? Remark { get; set; }
}

// 文件路径: MES.Core/DTOs/CreateCustomerRequest.cs
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using MES.Core.Enums;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace MES.Core.DTOs;

/// <summary>
/// 创建客户请求
/// </summary>
public class CreateCustomerRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 客户编码
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "客户编码不能为空")]
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "客户编码长度不能超过50")]
    public string CustomerCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// 业务员
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "业务员不能为空")]
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "业务员名称长度不能超过50")]
    public string Salesman { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// 客户单位
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "客户单位不能为空")]
    [StringLength(200, ErrorMessage = "客户单位长度不能超过200")]
    public string CustomerUnit { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// 最终用户
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(200, ErrorMessage = "最终用户长度不能超过200")]
    public string? EndCustomer { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 联系人
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "联系人长度不能超过50")]
    public string? ContactPerson { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 联系电话
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "联系电话长度不能超过50")]
    public string? ContactPhone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 联系地址
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "联系地址长度不能超过500")]
    public string? Address { get; set; }

    [JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]
    public CustomerStatus Status { get; set; } = CustomerStatus.Active;

    /// <summary>
    /// 备注
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "备注长度不能超过500")]
    public string? Remark { get; set; }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace MES.Core.DTOs;

/// <summary>
/// 创建牌号对照请求
/// </summary>
public class CreateGradeMappingRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 标准牌号
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "标准牌号不能为空")]
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "标准牌号长度不能超过50")]
    public string StandardGrade { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// 工厂牌号
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "工厂牌号不能为空")]
    [StringLength(50, ErrorMessage = "工厂牌号长度不能超过50")]
    public string PlantGrade { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// 密度
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "密度不能为空")]
    [Range(0.0001, 999.9999, ErrorMessage = "密度必须在0.0001到999.9999之间")]
    public decimal Density { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 热处理工艺
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(100, ErrorMessage = "热处理工艺长度不能超过100")]
    public string? HeatTreatment { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 是否特殊材料
    /// </summary>
    public bool SpecialMaterial { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 特殊注意事项
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "特殊注意事项长度不能超过500")]
    public string? SpecialNote { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 备注
    /// </summary>
    [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "备注长度不能超过500")]
    public string? Remark { get; set; }
}

    /// <summary>

/// 更新工单状态请求 DTO

{
    /// <summary>
    /// 工单状态（0=待处理，1=已确定，2=已取消）
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "状态不能为空")]
    [Range(0, 2, ErrorMessage = "状态值必须在0-2之间")]
    public int Status { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 乐观并发控制版本号
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "版本号不能为空")]
    public byte[] RowVersion { get; set; } = null!;
}

/// <summary>
/// 更新工单状态响应 DTO
/// </summary>
public class UpdateWorkOrderStatusResponseDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 工单ID
    /// </summary>
    public int Id { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 工单状态值
    /// </summary>
    public int Status { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 工单状态文本
    /// </summary>
    public string StatusText
    {
        get
        {
            return Status switch
            {
                0 => "待处理",
                1 => "已确定",
                2 => "已取消",
                _ => "未知"
            };
        }
    }
}
